column1: # pair in this directory is produced from the in-tree C build.
#   input_relpath      input FASTA, relative to the repository root
#   mafft_args         arguments passed to the C `mafft` wrapper before the
# Consumed by scripts/regen_policy_fixtures.sh (check | write). The reference
# is the pinned mafft-upstream source built in-tree with the upstream
# Makefile's default flags on the platform you run on; `.fma` is what that
# build produces on arm64/aarch64 (clang contracts a*b+c), `.nofma` on
# x86-64 (gcc does not). Never generate a variant from a downloaded binary.
